scope: Official ACP boolean configuration negotiation through Farfold initialization and the existing shared setter. Controlled manager/protocol fixture only.
rawLogBoundary: Each .txt is the original cargo subprocess stdout and stderr combined directly into a file. No output was reconstructed. JSON counts were parsed from those logs.
sourceIdentityBoundary: Source hashes identify the two owned working-tree files at receipt creation; this is not a freeze of the entire concurrent workspace or of each earlier red run.

integrationRegistration.change: Register #[cfg(test)] mod boolean_configuration_tests; child did not edit this file.

dependencyBasis.interpretation: The installed official schema defines an omitted/null boolean capability as unsupported and an object declaration as permitting boolean options and typed boolean setters. No upstream fork, patch or new dependency.

defect: Farfold already rendered and sent boolean configuration values but did not advertise support during initialize. A compliant capability-gated peer withheld those options.
minimalFix: Add the official schema boolean capability builder to the existing initialization request, preserving terminal authentication, form elicitation and existing metadata.
redObservation: Both boolean cases failed before any setter: initial boolean option was None rather than Some(Bool(false)). The select-only peer passed. This is a behavioral red run, not a compile failure.
coverage: Real AcpManager initialization and session opening against an owned Python JSON-RPC peer; the peer returns a boolean option only after receiving the declared capability.
Initial false and explicit true then false round trips, with exact session/config ids, type:boolean and actual boolean wire values; complete configOptions receipts retain the unrelated select value.
Terminal authentication, form elicitation, terminal-auth metadata and the existing sessionFailure metadata remain advertised.
Explicit protocol rejection keeps the peer value false and produces exactly one setter call; a later explicit choice succeeds without an automatic retry.
A select-only peer ignores the extension and retains the existing string-value setter; Farfold invents no boolean option.
Existing 17 session_config tests cover modern and older model/config methods, malformed or conflicting receipts, late acknowledgement, persistence failure and cold restore against controlled peers.
observedWarning: Cargo emitted an existing unused std::io::Write import warning at src/agent_install/archive.rs:97; this subtask did not edit that file.
notProven: Actual availability and use of boolean configuration in any real Agent, provider, account or model.
Installed application UI behavior, complete 29-Agent integration, Windows execution or full product acceptance.
General boolean response mismatch handling is a separate parent-owned frontend change and is not credited to this manager fix.
